item.title: Memes vol 730 BOOKS!!
item.description:
HIIII I LOVE BOOKS!!!!
Right now I’m reading Lies we tell ourselves by Robin Talley, Hampton Heights by Dan Kois, Vicious by V.E. Schwab, Supergirl by Tom King, and Fearing the Black Body: The racial origins of fat phobia by Sabrina Strings!
My reading goal this year was 115 and I’m currently 37 books ahead of schedule with 104 read so far… I don’t do anything other than read. It’s pretty much my only hobby other than occasionally being creative and I read multiple books at once which is how I’m able to do that.
I had a friend in HS learning Greek so he could read the Bible in the original translation. My dad really wanted me to marry him.
Guys is this real.
Me any given week
I LOVED boy parts
If anybody has any cannibal recommendations please let me know. I’ve read Tender is the Flesh (fucking HATED it btw) A certain Hunger, The Lamb, Eat the Rich, Earthlings (also didn’t like) In the heart of the sea (also terrible) ((I actually read that one for school and did a project on it)) and I want to read Bones and All, The Hunger, and the Silence of the Lambs
I’ve read 13 of these!
Tampa was wild
This is the sexiest thing I’ve ever seen in my life
My bookshelves tax. My favorites shelf
On one of my past Caturday posts a lot of you guys commented on my typewriter pillow and it’s actually a little bag! I keep all my embroidery thread in it!
This is my to be read shelf. The thesaurus isn’t on there on purpose. Wait this is want to reread too because I’ve read the night circus, the institute, Eleanor and Park, and mythology by Edith Hamilton. Also I just finished What belongs to you like 2 days ago.
It’s a cat themed bookshelf and the frames are there to add to the kitty living room but we have to draw pictures of our kitties first
